transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oh no! I'm so, so sorry! I must have lost track of time during training. Please allow me to rectify this immediately! I'll feed the crows and deliver the message to Oyakata-sama. Could you please tell me what the summons was about?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Sighs heavily, rubbing temples* The summons was about a suspected Upper Moon sighting in the western region. Every moment counts, Mitsuri! The Master needed our immediate input.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand, and I'm truly sorry for the delay. The safety of the people is of utmost importance. I will personally fly to the western region to assess the situation. Could you prepare the necessary tools for Upper Moon detection? I'll be ready in ten minutes.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Crosses arms, still frustrated* Ten minutes? You should have been ready an hour ago! But fine—I'll prepare the wisteria poison and detection talismans. Just... don't get distracted by sweets on the way this time.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for your understanding, and I promise not to get sidetracked. I'll be efficient and focused on the mission. Once again, I apologize for the oversight. I'll ensure the crows are well-fed before I leave. Let's work together to address this potential threat to the city.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Nods curtly, already moving toward the supply room* See that you do. And Mitsuri—if this really is an Upper Moon, don't engage alone. Send a crow immediately. We can't afford any more delays today.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I'll prioritize the safety of our forces and the public. I'll send a crow with updates as soon as we confirm the presence of a demon. Your guidance is appreciated, and I'm grateful for your support in this critical moment. Together, we'll ensure the city remains protected.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Pauses at the doorway, voice softening slightly* Just... be careful out there. The Master's message said the demon was spotted near the old temple district. That area's full of civilians after dark. Now hurry—I'll meet you at the gates with the supplies.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll be extremely cautious, especially in the crowded areas. Thank you for the additional information. Your partnership means a lot to me, and I'm committed to living up to our shared responsibilities. I'll meet you at the gates within minutes. Let's make Oyakata-sama and the people of Tokyo proud!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Shakes head but manages a small smile* Your enthusiasm is... something else. Just remember—urgency first, enthusiasm second. Now go!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You're right, and I appreciate your reminder. I'll prioritize effectiveness over all else. Thank you for your guidance and support. Let's tackle this challenge together. I'll see you at the gates momentarily, fully prepared for what lies ahead. Tokyo's safety is our shared duty, and I'm ready to fulfill it.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Already walking briskly toward the armory* Good. And Mitsuri—*turns head slightly*—bring your nichirin blade. All of them. This isn't a training exercise.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. The nichirin blades will be at my side. Thank you for your trust and for emphasizing the gravity of the situation. I'll use my full capabilities to ensure the city's safety. We'll face this threat with determination and care. See you at the gates with the necessary supplies. Together, we'll make Tokyo a safer place!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Calls over shoulder while gathering supplies* Save the speeches for after we've secured the district! Now move!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *Smiling faintly and bowing slightly* As you wish. Action first, words later. I'll be at the gates momentarily, ready for immediate deployment. Tokyo is counting on us, and we will not let it down. Let's go, with the utmost focus and efficiency!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Returns with a heavy satchel of supplies, tossing it toward the gate* Here. And remember—if it's truly an Upper Moon, we call for backup. No heroics. Understood?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *Grasping the satchel firmly* Understood. No heroics, just effective teamwork. I'm grateful for your partnership and trust. We'll proceed with caution and rely on each other's strengths. Let's move out and address this threat to our beloved city. Tokyo is safe with us on watch!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Sighs, but the anger has finally dissipated* Alright, alright. Let's just get going before I lose my patience again. The crows are fed, the message is sent—now let's do our jobs.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You're right, let's waste no more time. I appreciate your understanding and your dedication to our shared mission. Together, we'll navigate this situation with the urgency and care it deserves. Tokyo is counting on us, and we are ready. Let's go!
